notes.title: New update (1.8.8) & 2000 units & Demo
notes.notes:
Hello,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42587122/33d32139c1df1afeee70ec66c885f7f0a9a65a06.gif[/img]

Soon it will be 2000 pieces sold, thank You! I added a new update. I do not know whether to separate the volume options because in the game there is a radio, cb radio (police) and music + ambient sounds? If You have any problems with the game, ideas/suggestions - let me know (on forum, comments or review). Also, the demo is ready and will be released soon in a few days (February 4-14, 2023).

Update 1.8.8
- Demo (will be released on February 4-14, 2023)
- New options added
- New respawns for items (hidden somewhere in Retro Vegas)
- Fixes for AI
- Randomization of "Pyramids" in Retro Vegas (the map changes in Retro Vegas...).
- "Global" fixes for Mac OS (also for my other games on Steam E.g. Mumba IV)
- Collision fixes (on the Retro Vegas map)
- Graphic fixes (game and menus etc.)
- Fixes for localization (all 92 languages)
- Fixes for some sounds
- Other minor fixes
- Update for demo Windows 64 bits and 32 bits, Linux 64 bits, Mac OS 64 bits 
- Update for full version Windows 64 bits and 32 bits, Linux 64 bits, Mac OS 64 bits


Old updates: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2050310/discussions/0/3725072690817304554/

notes.title: Big update - new version 1.7.7 is available, 1000 units sold
notes.notes:
Hello,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42587122/1ab3b562e0ef72a2daaca8169deb7461e3b298c3.gif[/img]

1000 OutWave units sold, thank You! Also, OutWave DEMO and new updates are coming soon. For now there is a new big update (1.7.7) available on Steam.

- Graphical fixes (games, menus, etc.)
- Changes to police roadblocks
- Improved reflections
- New police car

notes.title: There is a new version 1.6.6 available on Steam
notes.notes:
Hello,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42587122/c1a0afdc3b47b2b76fa7489bd63a7bcecf853039.gif[/img]

A new version is available 1.6.6 - the version number is displayed in-game in the main menu under the logo. To update the game, you need to reset Steam and click update before launching. More information about the update can be found here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2050310/discussions/0/3725072690817304554/
